lines.text: Sparky the little dragon was building the tallest marble run in Dragon Valley!
A sudden gust of wind blew the whole tower down with a loud CLATTER!
Sparky's cheeks puffed up, smoke puffed from his nose, and his temper boiled!
He stomped his feet and was about to roar fire and scorch the grass!
His mama gently placed her paw on his shoulder and said, Smell the flowers!
Sparky breathed in through his nose like smelling roses... one, two, three!
Then he blew out through his mouth like cooling birthday candles... whooooosh!
Three deep breaths cooled the lava in his chest and brought back his bright smile!
Breathe easy and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for daily emotional skills!
